structured_data.objective: Using validation-only evidence, produce bounded research and risk directives for the frozen Phase 12 protocol. Never access test metrics.
structured_data.rationale: Dataset manifest (sha256: 0ed9091f...) confirms formal_v3 integrity. Restricting to validation partition only; test_metrics_accessible is forced false. Dry-run plan ensures zero compute cost while producing directives for later execution. Steps verify data, enumerate markets/symbols, define a split, validate config, estimate budget, and generate a report—all without touching test data.
